notes.title: Update: Japanese translation added, and a few minor improvements
notes.notes:
- Japanese translation added
- Custom court ceiling color changed
- Gamepad infinite vibration fixed

notes.title: Black screen hotfix
notes.notes: Some players reporting encountering with a black screen at the beginning of the game tried to be solved. We are not sure if this patch will solve all the black screen cases, but it aims to be a fast start.

notes.title: Early Access and the release
notes.notes: Volley Pals has a very few revisions before making to the release version. Please play it with your real friends if you can (more fun than bots for sure), and write your feedbacks here if you have some.
